title: Structural flat towers for an arrow diagram
statement: Under the hypotheses of lem-sc-flat-telescope-arrow-diagram, there exist three sequential towers of bounded-above flat complexes and level maps with the stated boundedness and flatness properties.

source.place: construction step of compatible flat resolutions

proof.text: Unpack the two isFlatTelescope hypotheses using [def-sc-flat-telescope-stage-map] to obtain their bounded-above flat towers E and E' and transitions t and t'. Take E₀=E₁=E and E₂=E', transitions t₀=t₁=t and t₂=t', identity level maps a and zero level maps b. Reuse boundedness and flatness of E twice and those of E' once to prove the six conjuncts. No compatibility of the level maps with f or transitions is required by this structural statement.

proof_origin.place: isFlatTelescope: unpack the given presentations and reuse their boundedness and flatness

lean.statement:
theorem exists_flat_telescope_arrow_core (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (P P' : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : isFlatTelescope Y P) (hP' : isFlatTelescope Y P') (f : P ⟶ P') :
    let A := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)
    ∃ (E₀ E₁ E₂ : ℕ → CochainComplex A ℤ)
      (t₀ : ∀ n : ℕ, E₀ n ⟶ E₀ (n + 1))
      (t₁ : ∀ n : ℕ, E₁ n ⟶ E₁ (n + 1))
      (t₂ : ∀ n : ℕ, E₂ n ⟶ E₂ (n + 1))
      (a : ∀ n : ℕ, E₀ n ⟶ E₁ n) (b : ∀ n : ℕ, E₀ n ⟶ E₂ n),
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero ((E₀ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E₀ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero ((E₁ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E₁ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero ((E₂ n).X i)) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ), SheafOfModules.IsFlat ((E₂ n).X i))
